key_points: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring.
Utilizes advanced technologies including Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Gen AI.
Capable of detecting objects and unusual situations with minimal human intervention.
Live recording and real-time data processing for immediate insights.
Advanced object detection capabilities, identifying various objects and anomalies.
Customizable alerts that allow users to respond quickly to incidents.
Multiple deployment options including Aksha on Edge and Cloud.
Flexible architecture with UI and backend options tailored to business needs.
Supports both on-premise and cloud-based solutions for scalability.
Customized version of Aksha developed for worker safety in collaboration with NDIL.
Integration of Edge + Cloud architecture for enhanced performance.
Phased development approach with continuous support and optimization.
Phase I: Initial deployment on Raspberry Pi 4B with dual OS support.
Phase II: Enhanced features using Gen AI and improved cloud architecture.
Phase III: Final optimizations and advanced features for better user experience.
Enhances employee safety by providing real-time monitoring and alerts.
Reduces operational risks through automated anomaly detection.
Improves decision-making with insightful report generation and analysis.
Ideal for businesses prioritizing workplace safety and security.
Applicable in various sectors including manufacturing, logistics, and retail.
Supports compliance with safety regulations through continuous monitoring.
For more information, visit: https://aksha.algoanalytics.com/
Contact us at: aksha@algoanalytics.com
Office Location: Alacrity India Innovation Centre, Pune.
Aksha represents a significant advancement in intelligent surveillance technology.
Combines AI and Gen AI to provide a robust solution for modern business challenges.
Investing in Aksha enhances safety, efficiency, and operational excellence.
